title: PeerStream
tagline: Live Stream Platform on web3  with LivePeer (API ,mobile app, website)
description: we created web3 live stream  platform with livepeer. We have API, website, and mobile app.We have used Wallet connect interaction for web3 connection. We are using lens protocol for get user nft data. We created flutter mobile app and connect it with our API service. We have auth, create stream, watch streams, and comment to live stream api gateways. We have built platform like a twitch. Users can generate video nft with us. Pls Check this link https://github.com/peer-stream
how_its_made: Please Check this link https://github.com/peer-stream We have our api services which use nodejs, and mongo db. We generated our website with react. We have used FLUTTER  for our mobile app.  Our main focus is live streaming so our backend fully integrated with live peer. Our api service using their api service for create and serve live streams
